name: fred_custom_series
description:
Any FRED series by id, from FRED, the St. Louis Fed's database of economic time series (rates, prices, employment, output, money, regional data).
Returns {"series": "<series_id>", "data": <FRED observations response>}; data.observations = [{date (YYYY-MM-DD), value (a string, "." if missing), realtime_start, realtime_end}], newest first; data is {"error": ...} if the call fails.
Inputs (* required): series_id* (string, a FRED series id such as UNRATE, DGS10, CPIAUCSL or T10Y2Y; ids are listed on fred.stlouisfed.org), limit (integer, number of newest observations; omitted: 60, although the schema default says 30).
Use it for series without a dedicated fred_* tool; the fred_* tools (fred_cpi, fred_10yr_treasury, ...) fix the series id for common indicators.
Example: {"series_id": "UNRATE", "limit": 24}
API key: env FRED_API_KEY (config fred.api.key); when unset the placeholder DEMO_KEY is sent.

limit.description: Number of most recent observations to return (newest first)
